note: P4368 (Pro 30:14) — there are those whose teeth are swords, to devour the poor from the earth.

dims.v: rapacious cruelty — teeth like swords, consuming the poor and needy
the devouring of the poor and needy by those whose teeth are swords and fangs knives — the rapacious cruelty that consumes the weak off the earth, greed turned predator upon the helpless
the predatory cruelty that eats up the defenceless

akal (eat/devour) — 'to DEVOUR the poor from off the earth, the needy from among mankind' (30:14); the last mark of a corrupt generation is rapacious cruelty — greed with a predator's teeth, consuming the weak. Emergent: oppression as devouring, the wicked feeding on the poor (cf 28:15; Ps 14:4; Amos 8:4).
